from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CashBalanceRecord(BaseModel):
    """Captures the beginning cash balance reported in a single company's filing."""
    registrant_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company filing the report (e.g. 'BIOLARGO, INC.')")
    beginning_cash_value: float | None = Field(description="The numerical value of the beginning cash balance")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="How the value is scaled in the document (e.g. 'thousands', 'dollars')")
    balance_date: str | None = Field(description="The date the balance reflects (e.g. 'December 31, 2023')")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The filing period covered by the report")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Short verbatim text containing the balance and date")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_balance_records: list[CashBalanceRecord]
